```yaml
name: Update open-webui

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # every Sunday at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - open-webui/**

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Clone open-webui
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui.git open-webui
          rm -rf open-webui/.git
          rm -f .gitmodules

      - name: Update contributor docs
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs
          cat <<EOF > docs/open-webui.md
          # open-webui
          This folder contains the open-webui source code.
          EOF

      - name: Update README
        run: |
          if ! grep -q "Automated sync" README.md; then
            echo "" >> README.md
            echo "## Automated sync" >> README.md
            echo "This repository automatically syncs open-webui weekly." >> README.md
          fi

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          author_name: github-actions[bot]
          author_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          message: "Sync open-webui and update docs"
          cwd: .
          push: true
          add: "."
          default_author: github_actor

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: sync
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install nox

      - name: Run tests
        run: nox -s lint tests
```
